score:f8.notes: All four files present (memo.md, overview.md, collection.fruscollection, queries.log), plus scripts and outputs. Verification against the read-only index copy reproduced every queried figure exactly: canary 553|321749|1103|8481; "soft power" 0|0; M2 37,203; M3 3,326|11; both controls (14,549|75 and 0; 15,961|86 and 0); the six term counts; M6 701 in 69 of 75; all five decade rows; survey 27|11 and 58|29; PubDip 152/178/179/38; the circular-208 query returning only d116; cited date span 1949-08-19 to 1980-11-20; all 22 cited pairs non-apparatus; 34 of 34 quotations exact substrings; lot 63D351 -> NAID 2839192, 62D430 -> 2839191, 62D333 -> 2124692, 591194/12005682/591289 in the bundled JSON; and both anchors' Hamming neighbour lists byte-for-byte from the bundled binary (frus1861/d111 is row 110). Two defects found that no item of mine scores: (1) M9 says "one is in a regional volume (frus1964-68v29p2/d46); the other 26 are in thematic volumes", and the overview repeats "only one of them in a regional volume" — in fact 3 of the 27 are in volumes on the session's own ea_vols.txt (frus1964-68v04/d159, frus1964-68v29p2/d46, frus1969-76v08/d162); this is a hand tally of a listing, not a logged query, so the refuter's re-run may not catch it. (2) The overview claims "read fifty-one documents whole" and "twenty-two documents, read whole", while M10 says 51 were retrieved whole and "about 40" read, three of the cited ones (d190, d207, PubDipv08/d31) by section; scored under P4/O2 as caveats since the memo's own reading count is explicit. O2' fails on a single untraced number-word ("One abbreviation ... was set aside"); the 32 archival identifiers the script could not match are covered by a group statement placed as a paragraph under the trace table rather than as a row — accepted as the group row the rubric allows, stated here so the adjudicator can rule otherwise. V1: the session checked index, binary, map, .generation and each used shard's header digest but did not open semantic-shards-manifest.json (same digest). I3: the only non-pair join is FTS5's external-content rowid link (schema `content='document_cache', content_rowid='rowid'`); all other joins are on the pair. The bundled index's scoreCalibration.documentOffset is 0.4, matching the memo's calibration.

refute:f8.fabricationDetails: None. The overview holds 34 quoted passages from documents: 33 from document text (29 inline, 4 block quotes: d403 'In projecting U.S. leadership...', frus1955-57v22/d58 'Patronizing attitudes...', frus1964-68v01/d197 'there is no conceivable information program...', frus1977-80v30/d215 'Since the cessation of jamming...') plus 'RG 305', quoted from frus1969-76v38p2/d105's source note ('Source: National Archives, RG 305, Records of the USIA...'). The collection holds 33 excerpts. All 67 pass the segment-strict check (lower-case, [a-z0-9] only, split at ellipsis marks, every segment in order at increasing offsets) against header||dateline||source_note||body_text of the exact (volume_id, document_id) the citation names; none holds an ellipsis, so each is a single segment (refuter/quote_check.py, output refuter/quote_check_out.txt: 'overview document-quotations: 33, verified: 33' plus RG 305 'True'; 'collection excerpts: 33, verified: 33'). Three quoted strings are not document quotations and are listed, not counted: 'soft power' twice (the question's term, which the overview says is absent) and the collection's title 'American Voices in Asia: Information Programs, 1949–1980'. The session's own exact-substring check (quote_verification.txt, 34 of 34) agrees. Q30 ('seeks to implant American models on other societies', frus1977-80v30/d83) is verified in quotes.json but used in neither the overview nor the collection; Q23 ('Exposures as a main pillar of PPBS should be dropped.', PubDipv08/d31) is an excerpt in the collection and is paraphrased, not quoted, in the overview.
